cohort: Over 30,000 active duty military women aged 18-40 years who experienced pregnancy
finding: While over 50% of women returned to their baseline BMI postpartum, preeclampsia and cesarean delivery were associated with greater weight gain and postpartum weight retention, highlighting the need for targeted weight management strategies in these groups.
mod_finding: Women with cesarean deliveries gained more weight during pregnancy, had more PPWR, and lost more weight from the third trimester to 6 months postpartum.
